## Pull request overview

This PR introduces a plugin-based mechanism for registering the ObjectQL engine with the `ObjectStackKernel`, aligns manifest types and tooling with new package categories (including `objectql`), and updates documentation and examples to reflect the new pattern.

**Changes:**
- Add `ObjectQLPlugin` and update `ObjectStackKernel` to support both explicit ObjectQL registration via plugins and a backward-compatible auto-initialization path.
- Extend the manifest schema, JSON schema, and tests to recognize additional package types (`objectql`, `gateway`, `adapter`) and document them.
- Update runtime README, quickstart docs, and examples (host, MSW, custom ObjectQL) and add a standalone validation script to demonstrate and validate the plugin-based ObjectQL registration.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 16 out of 16 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `test-objectql-plugin.ts` | Adds a standalone validation script that exercises plugin-based, backward-compatible, and custom-instance ObjectQL integration with the kernel. |
| `packages/types/src/index.ts` | Extends `IKernel` with an optional `ql` property to allow runtime plugins (like `ObjectQLPlugin`) to attach the ObjectQL engine instance. |
| `packages/spec/src/system/manifest.zod.ts` | Updates the manifest Zod schema to include new package `type` enum values (`objectql`, `gateway`, `adapter`) with descriptive comments. |
| `packages/spec/src/system/manifest.test.ts` | Expands tests to cover the new manifest `type` values and adds concrete examples for `objectql` engine, gateways, and adapters. |
| `packages/spec/json-schema/system/Manifest.json` | Regenerates JSON Schema for the manifest to include the extended `type` enum set. |
| `packages/spec/json-schema/hub/ComposerResponse.json` | Aligns the ComposerResponse manifest schema with the updated manifest `type` enum values. |
| `packages/runtime/src/objectql-plugin.ts` | Introduces `ObjectQLPlugin` implementing the runtime plugin interface, encapsulating ObjectQL initialization and attaching `ql` to the kernel via `install`. |
| `packages/runtime/src/kernel.ts` | Refactors `ObjectStackKernel` to detect `type: 'objectql'` plugins, fall back to auto-initialization when absent, and route all ObjectQL access through an `ensureObjectQL()` guard. |
| `packages/runtime/src/index.ts` | Re-exports `ObjectQLPlugin` and existing kernel/runtime types from the runtime package entrypoint. |
| `packages/runtime/README.md` | Documents the runtime package, plugin-based ObjectQL registration, custom ObjectQL usage, and migration from hardcoded ObjectQL. |
| `examples/msw-react-crud/src/mocks/browser.ts` | Updates the MSW browser setup to register ObjectQL explicitly using `ObjectQLPlugin` before other plugins. |
| `examples/host/src/index.ts` | Adjusts the host example to use `ObjectQLPlugin` (and optionally a custom `ObjectQL` instance) when booting the kernel. |
| `examples/host/debug-registry.ts` | Updates the debug host script to register ObjectQL via `ObjectQLPlugin` alongside the todo app and in-memory driver. |
| `examples/custom-objectql-example.ts` | Adds a new example showcasing kernel startup with a custom-configured ObjectQL instance registered through `ObjectQLPlugin`. |
| `content/docs/references/system/manifest/Manifest.mdx` | Syncs manifest reference docs with the expanded `type` enum including `objectql`, `gateway`, and `adapter`. |
| `OBJECTQL_PLUGIN_QUICKSTART.md` | Provides a quick-reference guide for installing, using, and migrating to the ObjectQL plugin-based registration model, including advanced patterns and troubleshooting. |
</details>
